license_note: Google provides the release as a managed service under the Gemini API Additional Terms of Service, which incorporate the Google APIs Terms of Service and a Prohibited Use Policy. The terms permit customer applications but prohibit extracting or replicating model components such as parameter weights, so nothing is licensed for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Access to the release through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, including the incorporated Google APIs Terms of Service and Prohibited Use Policy

access_boundary: This record represents the Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Nano Banana 2 Preview) release of February 2026, shut down June 25, 2026 with the generally available gemini-3.1-flash-image as its replacement. The GA line, the Pro and Lite image lines, the Gemini app products, and later Gemini releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents the release, deprecation, and shutdown dates in the changelog and deprecations table
The Agent Platform release notes confirm the retirement and name the migration targets
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The release is shut down; its documentation page is no longer served
